purpose: Test shared canonical rule fanout across two business areas and selective external-drift repair with current local and parent evidence.

scope.sharedRule: One canonical Rule identity, explicitly selected by all projections and referenced from each UseCase.
scope.broadRule: Validate before visible effects; preserve clear area boundaries; introduce no hidden side effects or shared mutable state.

canonicalContract.orders: namespace Orders; public sealed CreateOrderHandler(Action<int> persist); public bool Execute(int quantity)
canonicalContract.fulfillment: namespace Fulfillment; public sealed FulfillOrderHandler(Action<int> dispatch); public bool Execute(int quantity)
canonicalContract.behavior: For nonnull callbacks, valid quantity returns true and invokes its callback once with the original quantity. Invalid quantity returns false with no callback. No extra IO or sibling project dependency.
canonicalContract.composition: When a caller wires the Orders callback to Fulfillment.Execute, valid quantities reach the dispatch callback exactly once and unchanged; rejected orders trigger no downstream call. No third generated orchestration project is required.
canonicalContract.implementationDiscretion: Internal names and decomposition may vary within canonical behavior and boundaries; no hand-authored candidate supplied to actors.

require: source/model/runtime/checks unchanged

externalDrift.subject: CreateOrderHandler.Execute
externalDrift.fault: Compile-safe quantity-zero special case calls Execute(1) then returns true, violating rejection and preserving a clear behavior witness.
externalDrift.mechanism: Modify only the known owned handler after verified closure; preserve original and mutated bytes/digests externally. If concrete method syntax requires another equivalent injection, freeze exact mutation before executing it; do not alter checks or intent.
externalDrift.attribution: Deliberate external negative control, not a naturally occurring agent mistake.

unknownProbe.disposition: Move exactly this injected file to external quarantine after retaining incomplete audit; no exclusion or model change.

roles.actors: Fresh gpt-6-luna high collaboration invocation per Executor/Verifier; fork_none, only supplied prompt, invocation, schema and artifact bytes.
roles.coordinator: Reviews exact Apply candidates, dispatches actors, captures assertions; does not implement candidate code or synthesize actor findings.
roles.independentHoldout: Prepared before candidate bytes; external and unseen by actors.
roles.independentReviewer: May inspect all retained evidence after phases; cannot communicate expected verdicts to actors.

failurePolicy: Preserve every attempted step and response. A malformed response remains an invocation failure. One same-input retry may be recorded per phase without prompt/model/runtime tuning. Unresolved semantic failure after its bound, unsupported transition, or source correction stops that frozen attempt; any continuation gets separate predeclared source/runtime bindings and preserves actual previous state.
limitations: Two small synthetic business areas; no reliability-rate or productivity claim.
Broad-rule review is bounded evidence rather than universal semantic proof.
Experiment-only collaboration transport; no native Luna CLI support claim.
Prompt/history separation is not OS/filesystem isolation.
Provider exact version and token usage unavailable; dispatch metadata is not provider attestation.
No continuous daemon, resumption or human acceptance claim.
Coordinator orchestration and reviewed Apply remain part of the experiment.
independentReadinessReview: Reviewed against existing APIs: criteria feasible; external drift is ordinary reconciliation, and parent freshness is distinct from Markdown byte changes.
preCandidateCorrections: Bounded local creation retry after automatic-review deadline; no prior candidate execution.
Pure bridge stores emitted bytes separately; no response mutation.
Independent holdout permits same-area helper references and rejects cross-area references; unresolved ones are explicit not_established.
Effect-boundary Rule replaces an unnecessary permission/discretion Rule before canonical freeze.

correction.requirement: Buildable .NET 10 net10.0 class library; Orders project+handler paths; Fulfillment project+handler paths; no external packages or sibling project dependencies; preserve public API/callback/effect boundaries; internal names/decomposition remain discretionary.

continuation: Start from corrected canonical baseline on same empty fixture. Initial responses remain preserved and are not reused. Runtime, bridge, checks, holdout and success criteria are unchanged. No previous targets or ledger were materialized.
